text: The initial joint is the first part of the joint, the joint that moves into the varnish. It is the joint that is the first to show a sign of drying up. The varnish, on the other hand, is the last joint to come off the floor, the joint that is the one the baker starts to take to the oven. The joint that is the first to show signs of aging. The joint that shows signs of drying up, the joint that is the one the baker finally lets go of.
